create_JsonPipeTransport: create a JsonPipeTransport instance with an asyncio event loop and a pipe channel for JSON message transport
run_JsonPipeTransport: run the JsonPipeTransport transport to await the stopped future and process incoming messages
test_send_message: test the JsonPipeTransport send method to transmit a message dict through the pipe channel
refactor_request_stop: refactor the JsonPipeTransport request_stop method to signal connection closure via the pipe channel
review_connect_method: review the JsonPipeTransport connect method that registers message and closed event handlers on the pipe channel
